name: Drowned Abbey

conventions.alpha: every PNG is binary alpha (0/255) with RGB 0 under alpha 0; glow_add files are additive (black adds nothing) and must use an add blend
conventions.masters: files under _2x/ are 2x masters: draw at scale 0.5 with the same placement as the 1x file (crosshaven_art.gd prefers _2x)
conventions.grid: 64x32 diamonds; cell_to_local(x,y) = ((x-y)*32, (x+y)*16) = the diamond centre; south tip = centre + (0,16)
conventions.import: linear filter, no mipmaps, plain alpha
conventions.review_only: _mock/ has a .gdignore and is not game art

town_door.anchor: image bottom-centre = south tip of cell origin+[2,2] (Crosshaven kit rule: draw at cell_to_local(origin+(2,2)) + (0,16) + (-w/2, -h); 2x master at scale 0.5, same placement)
town_door.y_sort: z = (south cell x+y) * TILE_Z_SCALE + 2, as crosshaven_prop.gd; y-sort point = image bottom - 16 px
town_door.door_note: the ruined chapel's half-open door glows green on the SW (+y) face and a short plank pier runs out of it, ending at the SW edge of cell (1,2); the passable, clickable door cell is just outside the footprint at the pier end, origin+(1,3). The Door Keeper NPC (southbridge_door_keeper, body npc_door_keeper) stands beside it, e.g. origin+(0,3) (crosshaven_southbridge (23,26) for the chapel at (23..25, 23..25) and the door at (24,26)). The foundation's front-right corner and the pier posts overhang the footprint's south edges by a few px.
town_door.hatch_glow_note: the eerie green light in the half-open chapel door; additive blend (CanvasItemMaterial BLEND_MODE_ADD), same canvas and anchor as the building; fade modulate 0 -> 1 on hover of the door cell or the building

b.name: The Mire Abbess's sanctum (boss)
b.decal_note: the rune circle is a walkable 5x5 floor decal (the design's ring is ~4.2 tile widths across, a top-down circle of ~6 cells; 5x5 as the room layout asks): its outer ring and glyph band run through the 16 border cells and the cross sits on the centre cell. The inner 3x3 cells are the room's pads: draw the plain sanctum floor there (not candle_pad, the circle is the pad art) and add candle_pad_glow on those 9 cells

monsters.name: Bog Dead

facings.mirrors: the other two facings are game-side flip_h mirrors, as for the heroes: S flipped = front facing down-left, E flipped = back facing up-left

monsters.role: room A melee shambler: a drowned monk in a rotten robe dripping bog weed; double claw rake; melee: the attack connects on f06 (play the hit reaction / damage number there)
monsters.pawn_note: Hero-format cell (512x360, pivot (256,329)): place it exactly as the hero action cells. Same for the Mire Leech.
monsters.rise_note: when the Mire Abbess's Rite of Rising raises a fallen Bog Dead, play its death strip in reverse (f12 -> f00) on the corpse cell, then idle

monsters.name: Mire Leech

facings.mirrors: the other two facings are game-side flip_h mirrors, as for the heroes: S flipped = front facing down-left, E flipped = back facing up-left

release.note: spawn the projectile on this attack frame at point_px (cell pixels, same space as the pivot; mirror x about the cell centre for the mirrored facings)

monsters.role: room A ranged: a giant bog worm; attack = it rears back with its throat swelling (f01-f06) and spits a glob of acid bile on the release frame, projectile board/projectiles/bile_spit (lobbed), board/projectiles/bile_impact on hit

monsters.name: The Mire Abbess

facings.mirrors: the other two facings are game-side flip_h mirrors, as for the heroes: S flipped = front facing down-left, E flipped = back facing up-left

signature.name: Rite of Rising
signature.note: she raises a FALLEN Bog Dead on its death cell: she lowers the censer (f00-f02), swings it high over her head while the floating candles rise and flare (f03-f06); on f07 the green smoke bursts and the rite fires (stretch board/projectiles/rite_glow from rite_point to the corpse cell; the risen Bog Dead plays its own death strip reversed), she holds the censer high (f07-f09) and settles back to idle (f10-f13). The strip name stays 'summon' (14 frames)

rite_point.note: the censer on the signature's burst frame, per facing, in cell pixels (same space as the pivot); mirror x about the cell centre for the mirrored facings. Start rite_glow here and stretch it to the corpse cell

monsters.size_note: 1.5x the hero height: 768x540 cell, pivot (384,494) = the hero cell scaled 1.5x. Draw it exactly like a hero cell at the same sprite scale, but so that pixel (384,494) lands where a hero's (256,329) lands: for a centred Sprite2D, offset_boss = offset_hero + (0, (540-360)/2 - (494-329)) = offset_hero - (0, 75) (before scale).
monsters.role: boss: a tall drowned abbess with an iron-cross halo, a bronze censer on chains and three floating candles; attack = 'Censer Lash' (range 1-2), she whips the censer out on its chains and it connects on f06
